[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-kd[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Bank — acknowledge every transaction daily, prove it weekly[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Bryan restarts his daily bank habit right away. Every posted [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]transaction and deposit becomes one checkbox row in a monthly bank [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]note under a new `bank` sub-area of `cash`. Typing a row [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]acknowledges it. A weekly `bob bank import` of a Wells Fargo QFX [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]file writes, unchecked, only the rows he missed, and a balance [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]proof shows that nothing was skipped. Every total is computed when [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]it is drawn (terminal, month card, queue card, daily chip) and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]never written into notes. A missed week costs one sitting to catch [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]up, not a retyping spiral.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]5[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
